description_for_human: Track release health, blockers, overdue checks, and ownership from Copilot.
description_for_model: Always call this tool when the user asks about release readiness, release risk, blockers, or go-live status. The tool renders an interactive board with inline summary and fullscreen checklist. Pass releaseName to target a specific release, owner to filter checks by person, and showBlockedOnly=true to focus on blockers. For environment setup and testing, you can pass useMock=false together with dataServiceUrl to load real data from an HTTPS API endpoint.
